mai_policy: Use user-supplied MAI-Image-2 starting rates for both MAI models: text input $5, image output $33 per million tokens. Price num_output_tokens as image output for estimates; preserve raw modality gaps. Image-input rate unspecified; keep partial edit subtotals separate from complete totals.
all_model_cost_weighting: Mean repeats per model/prompt/source, then equal prompt weights; provider settings differ. A priced-prompt average excludes unpriced prompts. Full workloads require every prompt to be priced.
price_basis: OpenAI reference rates + user-supplied MAI-Image-2 starting rates (uncached inputs)
cache_policy: All input tokens use uncached rates
weighting: Average repeats per model/group, then equal weight for every matched group
